SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN candidates c ON ja.candidate_id = c.id WHERE ja.status = 'SHORTLISTED'
AND ja.job_demand_id = #{jobDemandId}
AND c.candidate_type = 'SELF_REGISTERED'
AND c.candidate_type = 'AGENCY_MANAGED'

SELECT ja.id AS application_id, ja.status AS application_status, ja.applied_at, ja.updated_at AS shortlisted_at, ja.reviewed_by AS shortlisted_by, ja.reviewed_by, ja.reviewed_at, ja.rejection_reason,
jd.id AS job_demand_id, jd.title AS job_title, ctry.name AS job_country, jd.city AS job_city, jd.description AS job_description, jd.requirements AS job_requirements, jd.salary_amount, jd.salary_currency, jd.total_slots, jd.remaining_slots,
c.id AS candidate_id, CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS candidate_name, c.trade AS candidate_trade, c.candidate_type, u.email AS candidate_email, u.phone_number AS candidate_phone, c.passport_number AS candidate_passport_number, c.date_of_birth AS candidate_dob, c.marital_status AS candidate_marital_status, c.profile_complete AS is_profile_complete, c.is_enabled, c.onboarding_stage,
a.id AS agency_id, a.full_name AS agency_name, a.email AS agency_email, a.phone_number AS agency_phone,
i.id AS interview_id, i.scheduled_at AS interview_scheduled_at, i.status AS interview_status, i.interview_link, i.interview_type, i.venue AS interview_venue, i.result AS interview_result, i.result_notes AS interview_result_notes,
doc.id AS document_id, doc.document_type, doc.document_name, doc.document_path, doc.status AS document_status, doc.rejection_reason AS document_rejection_reason, doc.uploaded_at AS document_uploaded_at
FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id INNER JOIN candidates c ON ja.candidate_id = c.id INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN countries ctry ON jd.country_id = ctry.id LEFT JOIN users a ON c.agency_id = a.id LEFT JOIN interviews i ON ja.id = i.job_application_id LEFT JOIN candidate_documents doc ON c.id = doc.candidate_id WHERE ja.id = #{applicationId} AND ja.status = 'SHORTLISTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN candidates c ON ja.candidate_id = c.id WHERE ja.status = 'SHORTLISTED' AND c.candidate_type = 'AGENCY_MANAGED' AND c.agency_id = #{agencyId}

SELECT ja.id AS application_id, ja.job_demand_id, jd.title AS job_title, ctry.name AS job_country, jd.city AS job_city, c.id AS candidate_id, CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS candidate_name, c.trade AS candidate_trade, c.candidate_type, a.id AS agency_id, a.full_name AS agency_name, ja.status, ja.applied_at, ja.updated_at AS shortlisted_at, i.scheduled_at AS interview_scheduled_at, i.status AS interview_status FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id INNER JOIN candidates c ON ja.candidate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN countries ctry ON jd.country_id = ctry.id LEFT JOIN users a ON c.agency_id = a.id LEFT JOIN interviews i ON ja.id = i.job_application_id WHERE ja.status = 'SHORTLISTED' AND c.candidate_type = 'AGENCY_MANAGED' AND c.agency_id = #{agencyId} ORDER BY ja.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
